Buzzword Bingo Card

Generate a random 5×5 corporate buzzword bingo card with a free center — click cells to mark them, regenerate, or print.

Tip: click a cell to mark it when someone says the buzzword. Five in a row wins the meeting.

📖 How to use

  1. Press New Card to shuffle a fresh 5×5 board.
  2. Click cells to mark them as buzzwords are said.
  3. Press Print Card for a paper copy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the card work?

The card is a 5×5 grid of 24 random buzzwords plus a free center square — just like real bingo.

Can I mark cells?

Yes — click any cell to mark it (it highlights), click again to unmark.

Can I print the card?

The Print button uses your browser's print dialog; each new card is freshly shuffled.
